E17: three real features on a real service, fifteen trials

Trials of one host share one time axis, in seconds from each trial's first event. Bars come from the kit's ledger; marks come from the host's own event stream by arrival time. A bar that is not under a sub-agent lane means the host does not say who ran it.

a step ran (kit ledger)a sub-agent was alive (the host's own record)a sub-agent was starteda collection returnedanother host eventa step was claimeda refused attempta later attempt (a redo)a fix attempt (the failed branch with main merged in)merged, re-test greentextual conflictmerged, re-test red, undonethe teammate's rename lands on main
